options.title: The same folder as the original

settings.title: Custom folder
settings.help: Used when Save results to is set to a folder of your choosing.

settings.title: Name suffix
settings.help: Added to the original's name; {preset} is the preset's word (gif, compressed, trimmed...). Existing files are never overwritten: a -2, -3... is added instead.

settings.title: Keep the original
settings.help: Off: the original is moved to the Trash after a job succeeds.

settings.title: Jobs at once
settings.help: How many ffmpeg jobs run at the same time (1-8); the rest wait in line.
